scope: bounded model-aligned CloudSEN12+ hard-negative spatial pilot
hypothesis: CloudSEN12+ negatives can improve unseen-site ranking only when represented by released-model probability morphology and localized temporal SWIR/MBMP structure, rather than global moments.

eligibility.label: isplume=false
eligibility.sensor: Sentinel-2 L1C target and exact published reference product

selection.hard_order: descending MBMP_std, descending MBMP_max, ascending SHA-256 scene identity
selection.diversity_order: country-round-robin by ascending SHA-256 scene identity, then global SHA-256 fill

pixel_contract.cloud_mask: all-clear uint8, permitted only because published target/reference-union statistics are exactly 40,000 clear and zero non-clear pixels

representation.scene_schema: 108 frozen released/residual probability and operational-input features
representation.spatial_schema: existing nine-channel 64x64 probability/SWIR/MBMP morphology tensor if scalar pilot passes

go_no_go.scalar_pilot: Cloud training negatives must improve the frozen MARS folds-2/3/4 AP by at least 0.002, preserve matched-FPR recall in every fold, and have positive paired-site AP lower 95% CI.
go_no_go.pixel_expansion: Acquire more than 512 CloudSEN12 crops only after the scalar model-aligned pilot passes its MARS selection and Cloud validation gates.
go_no_go.paper_access: No paper cache may be loaded until selection plus folds-0/1 confirmation pass.
